items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: George Hamilton is this fellow. He plays what?

ctx.x: Yeah. Now let me get my pencil off on it. That fellow there. Oh, I don't know him. That's why I tell you there's something that I don't know.
Now this is, this fellow here is Loomis Hamilton. That's George Hamilton's son. This is Bell. Well let's back up. He's a baritone.
